what_it_is.prose: This entry tracks Agnikul Cosmos's transition from its proven Agnibaan SOrTeD suborbital demonstrator (flown 30 May 2024) toward an operational orbital Agnibaan. After SOrTeD validated the single-piece 3D-printed Agnilet engine, avionics and Agnikul's private 'Dhanush' launchpad, the company signalled an orbital launch as its next major target and has continued propulsion work — including clustered multi-engine testing reported in 2026 as it moves toward a commercial launch phase. Agnikul has also publicly discussed reusability, including intent toward an India-first private orbital-class booster-recovery attempt. As of this verification the orbital vehicle has not flown; the programme is defined by demonstrated suborbital heritage plus stated development milestones rather than a confirmed orbital flight record. Firm orbital dates, payload commitments and recovery plans should be treated as provisional until Agnikul publishes primary confirmation.

deployments_procurement.summary: A development programme, not a fielded system; activity comprises engine/cluster testing and stated orbital and reusability milestones building on the 2024 suborbital flight.
